title: Crestline Fleet Account Early-Pay Discount Credits
content:
The early-pay discount on a Crestline Fleet Account is a credit customer care books on a fleet invoice that the business paid within its program's early-pay period. The early-pay discount policy decides whether a discount is due on an invoice and how much it is.

## When a remittance has left part of the invoice unpaid

The early-pay discount on an invoice that a remittance has paid only in part is credited only after an open dispute of an unapproved over-limit ticket registered for that invoice covers the part left unpaid.

Put another way: for an invoice that a remittance has paid only in part, the discount waits until the account's dispute list shows an open dispute of an unapproved over-limit ticket, registered for that same invoice, that covers the part left unpaid.

## Booking the credit

The tool is `credit_fleet_early_pay_23cbfed3`. Customer care handles it: the agent unlocks the tool and then calls it.

One call books one early-pay discount entry, dated today, against the invoice named, for the amount given, and lowers the fleet account's outstanding balance by the same amount; the invoice's open amount drops by it. Afterwards the discount appears in the account's activity as an early-pay discount applied to that invoice.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `fleet_account_id` | reference number of the business's fleet account, as shown by the fleet account lookup | identifier text |
| `source_fleet_txn_id` | reference number of the fleet invoice the discount is credited on, as shown by the fleet activity lookup | identifier text |
| `amount` | the early-pay discount credited | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places (cents); recorded rounded to 2 decimal places |

### Return

A text rendering of a receipt with these fields: `entry_id` (reference number of the new discount entry), `entry_type` (always `fleet_early_pay_discount`), `invoice_id` (the invoice credited), `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places, as booked), `posted_on` (YYYY-MM-DD date of the entry) and `outstanding_balance` (USD with 2 decimal places, the account balance after the credit). A receipt carrying `entry_id` means the discount was booked.
